title: From ambition to accountability: Quantifying AI ROI in strategy
summary: For many UK executives, AI investment has become a necessity, not an experiment in innovation. Yet, as Pete Smyth, CEO of Leading Resolutions notes, many SMEs treat AI as an exploratory exercise, not a structured business strategy.
